# Diagnostics

Every code the compiler can report, with the message shapes and help text its fixtures show. `compile --strict` (or `check --strict`) promotes warnings to errors.

## Syntax (SCH0xxx)

| Code | Severity | Category | Fires when | Message | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SCH0001 | error | syntax | the parser cannot continue at this token | missing ':' at 'uuid' | the parser stopped at the caret; a field is written `name: type`, a declaration `record Name { … }`, `enum Name { a, b }`, or `union Name = A \| B` |
| SCH0002 | error | syntax | a reserved keyword starts a declaration | 'service' is reserved for a future version of Schemata | rename the declaration; reserved words are listed in the language reference |
| SCH0003 | error | syntax | an integer or ordinal literal is out of range | number '99999999999999999999' is out of range<br>ordinal '#99999999999' is out of range | use a value that fits in 64 bits<br>use an ordinal that fits in 32 bits |

## Semantics (SCH1xxx)

| Code | Severity | Category | Fires when | Message | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SCH1001 | error | semantic | a namespace segment is not lower_snake | namespace segment 'Shop' must be lower_snake | write the segment in lower_snake, for example `shop` |
| SCH1002 | error | semantic | a type name is not UpperCamel | record name 'order_line' must be UpperCamel | rename it `OrderLine` |
| SCH1003 | error | semantic | a field name is not lower_snake | field name 'placedAt' must be lower_snake | rename it `placed_at` |
| SCH1004 | error | semantic | the same qualified name is declared twice | record 'R' is declared in both a.schemata:2 and b.schemata:2<br>record 'R' is declared more than once | rename or remove one of them |
| SCH1005 | error | semantic | a record repeats a field name | field 'x' is declared more than once in record 'R' | rename or remove one of the two fields |
| SCH1006 | error | semantic | a type name resolves to nothing | unknown type 'Missing' | declare `Missing`, import the namespace that declares it, or check the spelling against the builtin types |
| SCH1009 | error | semantic | a bare name matches several declarations | type 'T' is ambiguous; candidates: a.T, b.T | write the qualified name, for example `a.T`, or alias one import |
| SCH1010 | warning | semantic | a declaration shadows a builtin type | 'string' shadows the builtin type of the same name | rename the declaration; every bare use of `string` in this namespace now means yours |
| SCH1011 | error | semantic | an import names no namespace in the compilation | import 'nowhere' does not name a namespace in this compilation | add the file that declares `namespace nowhere` to the compilation, or fix the import |
| SCH1012 | warning | semantic | an import resolves nothing | import 'a' is unused | remove the import |
| SCH1013 | error | semantic | some elements have explicit ordinals and some do not | record 'R' mixes explicit and implicit ordinals | write `#n` on every element or on none |
| SCH1014 | error | semantic | an element has no explicit ordinal under --strict | field 'x' has no explicit ordinal (--strict) | write `#n` before every field and enum value, starting at #1 in declaration order |
| SCH1015 | error | semantic | an annotation name is unknown | unknown annotation '@nope'; known: deprecated, proto, sql | write one of the listed annotations, or run `schemata targets` for each target's keys |
| SCH1016 | error | semantic | a key is unknown for its annotation target | 'bogus' is not a key of @sql; keys: column, index, key, schema, strategy, table, type, unique | write one of the listed keys, for example `@sql(column)` |
| SCH1017 | error | semantic | an annotation key is on an element it does not apply to | @sql(column) is not allowed on a record; allowed on: field | move the annotation to a field, or remove it |
| SCH1018 | error | semantic | an annotation's arguments have the wrong shape or value | @deprecated expects a string<br>@sql needs at least one key<br>@proto needs at least one key<br>@sql arguments are a bare key or key = value<br>@deprecated takes a single value<br>@sql(column) expects a string | write `@deprecated("…")`<br>write `@sql(column = "…")`<br>write `@proto(name = "…")`<br>write `@sql(key)` or `@sql(key = value)`<br>write `@deprecated("value")` |
| SCH1019 | error | semantic | an ordinal is used twice in one declaration | ordinal #1 is used more than once in record 'R' | give each element its own ordinal; the next free one is #2 |
| SCH1020 | error | semantic | a name or ordinal is reserved in its declaration | name 'y' is reserved in record 'R'<br>ordinal #2 is reserved in record 'R' | pick another name; reserved names are kept out of use for old readers<br>pick another ordinal; the next free one is #3 |
| SCH1021 | error | semantic | a map key type is nullable | map key string? is nullable | write the key type without `?` |
| SCH1022 | error | semantic | a map key type is not string, int32, or int64 | map key bool must be string, int32, or int64 | use one of the three key types, or store the entries as a list of records |
| SCH1023 | error | semantic | an alias refers to itself | alias 'A' refers to itself | point the alias at a builtin or a declared type |
| SCH1024 | error | semantic | a nullable alias is marked nullable again | 'N' is already nullable | remove the `?` |
| SCH1025 | error | semantic | a union repeats a member | union member 'A' is repeated | remove the duplicate member |
| SCH1026 | error | semantic | a union contains itself | union 'U' may not contain itself | remove `U` from its own members; wrap it in a record if the recursion is intended |
| SCH1027 | error | semantic | a union member is nullable or a collection | union member list<R> must be a named type or a scalar | wrap the collection in a record, or drop the `?`; a union is absent through the field, not the member |
| SCH1028 | error | semantic | an enum value is not lower_snake | enum value 'Red' must be lower_snake | rename it `red` |
| SCH1029 | error | semantic | an enum repeats a value | enum value 'red' is declared more than once in enum 'C' | remove the duplicate value |
| SCH1030 | error | semantic | an enum has no values | enum 'C' has no values | declare at least one value |
| SCH1031 | error | semantic | a generic type has the wrong number of arguments | 'list' takes 1 type argument; got 2 | write `list<T>` |
| SCH1032 | error | semantic | a non-generic type is given type arguments | 'bool' is not generic | remove the type arguments; only `list` and `map` take them |
| SCH1033 | error | semantic | a nested type path names no nested type | type 'O' has no nested type 'Inner' | declare `Inner` inside `O`, or refer to it by its own qualified name |
| SCH1034 | error | semantic | a reserved range is inverted | reserved range #5..#3 is inverted | write the lower ordinal first: `reserved #3..#5` |
| SCH1035 | error | semantic | an ordinal is not positive | ordinal #0 is not positive | ordinals start at #1 |
| SCH1036 | error | semantic | an annotation key is given twice | @deprecated is given more than once | keep one of them |
| SCH1037 | error | semantic | a refinement key is unknown for the type | 'max' is not a refinement; bool takes no refinements<br>'size' is not a refinement of string; allowed: max, min, pattern | remove the parentheses; `bool` takes no refinements<br>write one of the allowed refinements, for example `string(max = …)` |
| SCH1038 | error | semantic | a refinement value is invalid for the type | max must be an integer literal<br>max must not be negative<br>max for int32 must be an integer literal<br>max 99999999999 is outside the range of int32<br>min 5 exceeds max 1<br>max for float64 must be a number<br>pattern does not compile: Unclosed group<br>pattern must be a string literal<br>only decimal takes positional refinements<br>precision must be at least 1<br>precision must be an integer literal<br>scale must not be negative<br>scale 5 exceeds precision 2 | write a whole number<br>use 0 or more<br>use a value between -2147483648 and 2147483647<br>swap or fix the bounds<br>write a number<br>fix the regular expression; Postgres and Java must both accept it, so keep to the shared subset<br>quote the pattern: `pattern = "^…$"`<br>name the refinement: `string(max = …)`<br>name the refinement: `list(max = …)`<br>write `decimal(p, s)` with p ≥ 1<br>use a scale of 0 or more<br>use a scale no larger than the precision |
| SCH1039 | error | semantic | refinements are written on a non-builtin type | 'E' is an alias and takes no refinements here<br>'A' is a record; only builtin types and collections take refinements | refine the alias where it is declared, or write the builtin type here<br>remove the parentheses |
| SCH1040 | error | semantic | decimal is missing its precision and scale | decimal needs precision and scale | write `decimal(p, s)`, for example `decimal(19, 4)` |
| SCH1041 | error | semantic | a refinement key is given twice | 'max' is given more than once | keep one of them |
| SCH1042 | error | semantic | a default does not fit the field's type | default for bool must be true or false<br>default for enum 'C' must be one of: red<br>default for int32 must be an integer literal<br>default 99999999999 is outside the range of int32<br>list fields cannot have a default<br>map fields cannot have a default<br>default for float64 must be a number<br>record fields cannot have a default<br>default for string must be a string literal<br>uuid fields cannot have a default<br>union fields cannot have a default | write `= true` or `= false`<br>write one of the listed values, for example `= red`<br>write a whole number<br>use a value between -2147483648 and 2147483647, or declare the field int64<br>remove the default; an empty list is the absence<br>remove the default; an empty map is the absence<br>write a number<br>remove the default; give the record's own fields defaults instead<br>quote the default: `= "…"`<br>remove the default; `uuid` has no literal form<br>remove the default; a union is chosen by the writer |

## Protobuf (SCH20xx)

| Code | Severity | Category | Fires when | Message | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SCH2001 | warning | lossy | something Protobuf cannot carry was dropped by the lowering | decimal has no Protobuf representation; lowered to string<br>default 3 is not carried by proto3<br>proto3 requires a zero value; synthesized C_UNSPECIFIED = 0<br>nullable list elements have no Protobuf representation; lowered to repeated<br>a nullable list has no Protobuf representation; lowered to repeated<br>a nullable map has no Protobuf representation; lowered to map<br>nullable map values have no Protobuf representation; lowered to map<br>refinements on string(max = 3) are not enforced by Protobuf | keep the string form; parse it in application code<br>drop the default or apply it in application code; proto3 has no field defaults<br>keep the synthesized zero value; proto3 reads an unset enum as 0<br>declare the list as `list<T>` with non-nullable elements; an empty list already means absent<br>declare the map as `map<K, V>` with non-nullable values; a missing key already means absent<br>enforce the refinement in application code; Protobuf carries no constraints |
| SCH2004 | error | semantic | two names lower to the same Protobuf name | proto name 'R' is already used by record 'R' (s.schemata:2)<br>namespaces a and b both lower to package 'p' | rename one of them, or set `@proto(name = "…")` on one<br>set `@proto(package = "…")` on one namespace |
| SCH2005 | error | semantic | a collection element is itself a collection | proto cannot nest collections; list<list<int32>> has a collection element | wrap the element in a record |
| SCH2006 | error | semantic | a field number or reserved number breaks Protobuf's rules | field number 19500 is reserved for the Protobuf implementation (19000 to 19999)<br>field number 600000000 exceeds the Protobuf maximum 536870911<br>reserved range 3 to 5 overlaps 2 to 4<br>reserved number 600000000 exceeds the Protobuf maximum 536870911<br>reserved number 0 must be positive | use an ordinal outside 19000 to 19999<br>use an ordinal of at most 536870911<br>merge or separate the two ranges<br>reserve ordinals of at most 536870911<br>reserve ordinals from #1 upward |
| SCH2007 | error | semantic | a @proto override is not a valid name | @proto(name = "1x") is not a valid identifier<br>@proto(package = "Bad Name") is not a valid package name | use letters, digits, and underscores, starting with a letter<br>use dotted lower-case identifiers, for example `shop.orders.v1` |

## Postgres (SCH21xx)

| Code | Severity | Category | Fires when | Message | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| SCH2102 | error | semantic | two namespaces lower to the same schema | namespaces a and b both lower to schema 'x' | set `@sql(schema = "…")` on one of them |

| SCH2106 | error | semantic | a record has no primary key and no field uses it | record 'Orphan' has no primary key and is not used by any field | mark its key fields with `@sql(key)`, or the record with `@sql(key = (a, b))`; a keyless record only lowers when a field embeds it |

| SCH2108 | error | semantic | embedding a record would recurse | embedding 'A' here would recurse (A → B → A) | use `@sql(strategy = json)` on this field, or give 'A' a key so it becomes a table |
| SCH2109 | warning | semantic | an identifier exceeds Postgres's 63-byte limit and was truncated | identifier 'a_very_long_field_name_that_goes_on_and_on_past_the_postgres_limit_of_sixty_three_bytes' exceeds 63 bytes; truncated to 'a_very_long_field_name_that_goes_on_and_on_past_the_pos_e96220f' | shorten the name with `@sql(table = "…")` or `@sql(column = "…")` to choose it yourself |
